task.title: P6-106: [parked] Clean up orphaned card_tags on per-card holding/desire removal
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-106. Size: S. Specs: specs/card-tagging.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Per-card `card_tags` orphan cleanup** — when a card's **last** holding and desire leave a deck (quantity → 0 via the stepper, a move, or teardown of a single line), drop its now-orphaned `card_tags` rows. Whole-collection teardown is already covered by the `ON DELETE CASCADE` on `card_tags.collection_id`; this is the per-line case on the holdings/desires write paths, and no such cleanup exists today.

**Trigger: a UI surfaces stale tags** — which is the spec's own condition (`card-tagging.md:333-336`).
